cases.translation: The earth cried out to the Lord.
cases.explain: Земля is the subject of воскликли (cried), so it takes the nominative case.
The verb служите (serve) governs the dative case.
After в (into) indicating motion, the accusative case is used.
After во (into), the accusative plural case indicates direction of movement.

cases.translation: Praise the Lord and bless Him.
cases.explain: The verb благодарите (praise) takes the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.translation: Praise Him and bless the name of the Lord.
cases.explain: The preposition о (about/of) governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Мы народ Его и овцы ___ стада.
cases.translation: We are His people and the sheep of His pasture.
cases.explain: The possessive relationship uses genitive case to show His pasture.
The verb принадлежим (belong to) takes the dative case.

reading.ru: Воскликни Господу вся земля, служите Господу с радостью.
reading.question: What should we do and with what emotion?
options: Cry to the Lord and serve with joy
reading.correct: Cry to the Lord and serve with joy
reading.explain: The passage says to cry to the Lord and serve Him with joy.

reading.ru: Знаете, что Господь Бог, Он сотворил нас, и мы принадлежим Ему.
reading.question: What did the Lord do and what relationship do we have with Him?
options: He created us and we belong to Him
reading.correct: He created us and we belong to Him
reading.explain: The text states that God created us and we belong to Him.

reading.ru: Входите в ворота Его с благодарением и во дворы Его с хвалою.
reading.question: How should we enter God's gates and courtyards?
reading.explain: We should enter His gates with thanksgiving and His courts with praise.

reading.ru: Благодарите Его и благословляйте имя Его, ведь Господь благ.
reading.question: What two things should we do, and what is true about the Lord?
options: Thank and bless His name because He is good
reading.correct: Thank and bless His name because He is good
reading.explain: We should give thanks and bless His name because the Lord is good.

reading.ru: Милость Его навеки и верность Его из поколения в поколение.
reading.question: How long do God's mercy and faithfulness last?
reading.explain: His mercy endures forever and His faithfulness from generation to generation.

reading.ru: Мы народ Его и овцы Его стада.
reading.question: What image describes our relationship with God?
options: We are His people and sheep of His pasture
reading.correct: We are His people and sheep of His pasture
reading.explain: We are described as God's people and the sheep of His flock.
